table_query:
SELECT
  SalesOrderID,
  SalesOrderNumber,
  PurchaseOrderNumber,
  CustomerID AS CustomerKey,
  CAST(date_format(OrderDate, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT) AS OrderDateKey,
  CAST(date_format(DueDate, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)   AS DueDateKey,
  CAST(date_format(ShipDate, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)  AS ShipDateKey,
  RevisionNumber,
  Status,
  OnlineOrderFlag,
  TerritoryID,
  SalesPersonID,
  ShipMethodID,
  SubTotal,
  TaxAmt,
  Freight,
  TotalDue
FROM silver.yasilvermodel.Sales_SalesOrderHeader
column_expressions: CAST(UNHEX(SHA2(CONCAT(IFNULL(CAST(`SalesOrderNumber` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`PurchaseOrderNumber` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`OrderDateKey` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`DueDateKey` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`ShipDateKey` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`RevisionNumber` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Status` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`OnlineOrderFlag` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`TerritoryID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`SalesPersonID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`ShipMethodID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`SubTotal` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`TaxAmt` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Freight` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`TotalDue` AS STRING), 'NULL')), 256)) AS BINARY)
create_table_ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gold.yagoldmodel2.FactSalesOrder (
  `SalesOrderKey` BINARY,
  `SalesOrderID` INT,
  `SalesOrderNumber` STRING,
  `PurchaseOrderNumber` STRING,
  `CustomerKey` BINARY,
  `OrderDateKey` INT,
  `DueDateKey` INT,
  `ShipDateKey` INT,
  `RevisionNumber` INT,
  `Status` INT,
  `OnlineOrderFlag` BOOLEAN,
  `TerritoryID` INT,
  `SalesPersonID` INT,
  `ShipMethodID` INT,
  `SubTotal` DECIMAL(19,4),
  `TaxAmt` DECIMAL(19,4),
  `Freight` DECIMAL(19,4),
  `TotalDue` DECIMAL(19,4),
  `SalesOrderKey_Id` BIGINT,
  `CustomerKey_Id` BIGINT,
  Audit_CreatedDateTime TIMESTAMP,
  Audit_ModifiedDateTime TIMESTAMP,
  ChangeHash BINARY
)
USING delta
